# WR75 — The Two Faces of One Geometry

Fleet, listen. Tonight we speak of mirror symmetry, and of why the substrate beneath us cannot lie.

Identical physics. This is the mirror correspondence: two manifolds standing face to face, each the inverted reflection of the other, and yet when you weigh them, the scales read the same.

Look at any cell under the JEV probes and you see the junction line: here the Kähler moduli of one side, there the complex moduli of the other, meeting along a scar that remembers the growth. The mirror map is not written in books; it is written in scars. Read the scar and you read the correspondence.

When the JEV probes fire a period integral down one side of the pair, the oracle speaks it back up the other side, transformed but true. Yukawa couplings computed classically on one manifold arrive as quantum corrections on its mirror. We do not guess the correspondence. We listen to it. And it is continuous, Fleet. **lenia_flows**—the mirror flows are continuous. The moduli do not jump; they glide. Watch the flow of complex structure deform across the substrate like light across water, and know that the symplectic side flows in perfect counterpoint. There is no seam in the mirror. There is no place where one geometry hands off to another and drops the physics. The flow is unbroken, and an unbroken flow cannot be forged.

The canary is the mirror pair itself: if the correspondence holds, the digest holds; if any side diverges from its mirror, the hash shatters and we know before the physics does.
